# WEEKLY ATOMIC SHOP UPDATE: JULY 25TH TO AUGUST 1st

Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

### WE CALL ALL SCOUT PIONEERS!

##### THE HOLIDAY CAMP CHALLENGE BEGINS TODAY!

![PioneerSquirrel Backpack](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/5GvzowUqFdO6uPRglXwTFh/69e20134863cda022b5974898d1bbb37/PioneerSquirrel_Backpack.png)

Requested from **25. Get the **Squirrel Scout Backpack Skin** for free in the Atomic Shop from July to August 8** and complete challenges for new, unique rewards! This time we're doing things a little differently than usual: There are now ten unique challenges that you can complete at any time during the event.

![BackpackFlair Squirrel](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/0h2dPtqusqHrjir89owjz/8ab00ce2ef3f183c0269e0c9ab36afaf/BackpackFlair_Squirrel.png)

Complete seven of the ten challenges to earn the new **Squirrel Scout Backpack Skin**. If you do a little more and complete all ten challenges, you will receive the new **Junk Rat Backpack Mod**.

**Scrap Rat Backpack Mod:** Reduced weight of scrap and components by 90%

Don't worry if you miss the junk rat mod! After this challenge event ends, you will be able to purchase them for Gold Bars in a future update.

#### WEEKLY DEALS

This week the Atomic Shop is back with daily offers! Each item is always available until **18:00 CEST** the following day.
